dec: I completed my Level 3 Web Development course at CEAD University, graduating with an A+ grade. This intensive program gave me a deep understanding of full-stack development, with a strong emphasis on frontend technologies. Throughout the course, I gained hands-on experience in building responsive websites, developing dynamic user interfaces, and connecting frontend with backend systems. This training sharpened my skills and gave me the confidence to create modern, scalable, and user-focused web applications.

I completed the Kamyab Jawan Youth Entrepreneurship Program, a government-backed initiative designed to empower young individuals with entrepreneurial skills and web development expertise. During this course, I gained practical knowledge in web development technologies, including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and responsive design principles. I developed the skills to create user-friendly websites and learned how to integrate web development with entrepreneurial thinking. This experience not only enhanced my technical abilities but also strengthened my problem-solving skills and mindset, enabling me to build impactful digital solutions for future projects.
